info.title: stability/control-sketch
info.description: The request body Comfy Router accepts for the model "stability/control-sketch", and the response body it returns. The INPUT schema is the same schema the server validates a call against before it reaches the provider, so what is published and what is enforced cannot differ. `x-comfy-router-input-modalities` records the media kinds the model is documented to accept; the request schema is shared across sibling models and may admit media kinds this model ignores. The OUTPUT schema describes the provider's native result document exactly as Router returns it: Router does not validate, narrow or re-envelope the response, so the output schema is descriptive rather than enforced, and Comfy owns no output shape of its own.

schema.description: Comfy Router request for Stability Control Sketch and Control Structure, in Stability's v2beta control fields sent as a JSON object. One source image is redrawn following the prompt. Returns one PNG image and is billed once per call.

control_strength.description: How closely the result follows the source image. Default 0.7.

image.description: A Comfy-signed asset URL of the source image.

negative_prompt.description: What to keep out of the image.

prompt.description: What to generate from the source image.

seed.description: 0 or omitted picks a random seed.

200.description: OK - the model's native JSON output, returned unchanged; the schema describes the provider's terminal result document as Router returns it.

schema.description: Comfy Router output schema for the Stability image models. The image is generated on Comfy-hosted infrastructure and stored on Comfy storage: `image` is a Comfy-signed URL valid for up to 24 hours, not a Stability URL, so download it before then. If the image cannot be stored, the call answers 502 and is not billed; no other URL is returned.

image.description: Comfy-signed URL of the (first) PNG image, valid for up to 24 hours.

images.description: SDXL only, when more than one image was returned. Every Comfy-signed image URL, in output order, each valid for up to 24 hours.

seed.description: The seed the image was generated with.
